payload.description:
As a platform operator, I want Plexus CloudWatch logging to use IAM role credentials and redact sensitive values before log emission, so that new-account logging can be enabled without static keys or unprotected PII.

Feature: Protected CloudWatch logging

Scenario: CloudWatch log shipping starts with role credentials
Given AWS region is configured and no static AWS keys are required
When Plexus initializes CloudWatch logging
Then the CloudWatch Logs client is created through the default credential provider chain
And app-side redaction is active before any CloudWatch handler receives log text
And the CloudWatch data protection policy is applied before log shipping is enabled.

Scenario: Protection cannot be established
Given AWS region is configured
When the data protection policy cannot be applied
Then Plexus does not attach a CloudWatch log handler
And local logging continues.
payload.title: CloudWatch logs are redacted and keyless
